description: This file defines the CustomField model class within the Opencart system, responsible for retrieving custom field data from the database, including individual fields and collections filtered by customer group.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Model class that interacts with the database to fetch custom field data, supporting retrieval of individual and multiple custom fields with filtering options.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Fetches a single custom field record from the database based on a given custom field ID.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves a list of custom fields, optionally filtered by customer group, including associated values for specific input types like select, radio, and checkbox.
